purpose: Predeclare the deterministic post-bakeoff refit rule before any of the four frozen CFB candidate attempts are evaluated.
rationale: The latest outer fold's alpha was chosen only from nested expanding folds strictly earlier than that outer season. Reusing that already-preregistered nested alpha for the final all-row refit avoids any post-result hyperparameter search or tuning.
activation_rule: This policy may build a hash-bound zero-authority model proposal after a frozen winner exists. FROZEN serving status and any forward evidence clock require a separate refs/heads/main freeze commit binding the exact artifact and manifests.
